# "The Arts" Ewer and Basin

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** "The Arts" Ewer and Basin
- **Artist / Maker:** Jules-Paul Brateau French, 1844-1923 Paris, France
- **Date:** 1887/89
- **Style / Period:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** ewer (vessel)
- **Department:** Applied Arts of Europe
- **AIC artwork ID:** 618
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/618
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/f6093dc6-a3c2-f783-f921-a9bb8449c6c6/full/400,/0/default.jpg
